escalations.title: Vitest UI Server — Arbitrary File Read and Execution
escalations.reason: Missing access control (CWE-862); CVSS 9.8; any attacker with network access to dev server can read arbitrary files and execute code
escalations.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest@latest  # requires v4.1.10+

escalations.title: Handlebars — Multiple JavaScript Injection Vectors (8 CVEs)
escalations.reason: Code injection via AST type confusion (CWE-94); CVSS 9.8; prototype pollution chains; if user-supplied data reaches templates, full compromise is possible
escalations.cve: GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q (lead), + GHSA-3mfm-83xf-c92r, GHSA-xhpv-hc6g-r9c6, GHSA-xjpj-3mr7-gcpf, GHSA-9cx6-37pm-9jff, GHSA-2qvq-rjwj-gvw9, GHSA-7rx3-28cr-v5wh, GHSA-442j-39wm-28r2
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars@latest  # requires 4.7.9+; audit which direct dep brings it in via: npm ls handlebars

escalations.title: @grpc/grpc-js — Server Crash via Malformed Requests (DoS)
escalations.reason: Orchestrator availability; malformed or corrupted gRPC messages crash the server (CVSS 7.5 each); infrastructure at risk

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer targets wrong requirements file — CI gate prints false PASS
backlog.detail: Enforcer auto-selects most recently modified requirements.md (Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md, 13 FRs) instead of domain spec (Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md, 74 FRs). CI exits 0 while 74 domain requirements are untraced.
backlog.recommendation: Pin enforcer in inspector.config.yml: python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md

backlog.title: 0% domain spec coverage — all 74 requirements untraced in Source/
backlog.detail: FR-001 through FR-069 (plus dependency FRs) have zero // Verifies: FR-XXX comments anywhere in Source/. Implementation was built against plan-level spec (FR-WF-001 to FR-WF-013). Domain spec describes a different system (SQLite, 7 frontend pages, pipeline orchestration).
backlog.recommendation: Product-level decision required: (a) archive domain spec in favour of plan-level spec, or (b) treat domain spec as next implementation target and backfill Verifies comments. Update CLAUDE.md to clarify which spec is authoritative.

backlog.title: Direct store access from 3 route handlers — service layer bypassed
backlog.detail: workItems.ts, workflow.ts, and intake.ts import and call the store directly (store.createWorkItem, store.findAll, store.findById, store.updateWorkItem, store.softDelete). CLAUDE.md rule: No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.
backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts wrapping all store operations. Route handlers call service; service calls store.

backlog.title: brace-expansion — 4 DoS CVEs via Exponential and Unbounded Expansion
backlog.fix: npm update brace-expansion@latest (run in Source/Backend, Source/Frontend, platform/orchestrator)

backlog.title: /api/search route not registered — 1 test file intentionally failing CI
backlog.detail: Test file documents the GET /api/search contract but the route is not wired into app.ts. File comment: 'tests will FAIL until route is implemented. This is intentional.' Breaks CI gate.
backlog.recommendation: Implement GET /api/search and wire into app.ts (tests define the contract), OR gate with test.skip and a ticket reference.

backlog.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage inflate pass counts
backlog.detail: Both Source/Frontend/tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx and Source/Frontend/tests/pages/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx test the same component. Same for WorkItemListPage. Artifact of two coders working independently.
backlog.recommendation: Consolidate into the pages/ variant (more complete); delete root-level duplicates or merge unique assertions.

backlog.title: Duplicate logger shim — two-layer logger stack in production
backlog.detail: src/logger.ts is a shim that re-exports src/utils/logger.ts with a normalize() adapter. Routes import from ../logger (the shim). Two-layer logger stack created by multiple pipeline coders using different import paths.
backlog.recommendation: Consolidate to single canonical logger. Update src/utils/logger.ts to accept both object and string signatures; delete src/logger.ts; update all imports.

backlog.title: OpenTelemetry not implemented — traceparent header not propagated
backlog.detail: CLAUDE.md and FR-021 mandate OpenTelemetry. No @opentelemetry/* packages in Backend package.json; no traceId/spanId in log output; traceparent header neither read nor forwarded across service boundaries.
backlog.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node and @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node. Initialize in app.ts before routes. Inject trace_id and span_id into log entries. Read and forward traceparent on outgoing calls.

backlog.title: Domain spec requires SQLite; implementation uses in-memory store with no persistence
backlog.detail: FR-002 requires SQLite + schema migrations; FR-035 requires pipeline_runs/pipeline_stages tables; FR-052 requires cycle_feedback table. Implementation uses in-memory Map with optional JSON file persistence. All data lost on backend restart.
backlog.recommendation: Product decision required: update domain spec to reflect in-memory design (if approved), or plan SQLite migration using Knex.

backlog.title: form-data — CRLF Injection in Multipart Form Encoding
js-yaml — Quadratic-Complexity DoS via Merge Key Aliases
7 packages 1+ major versions behind — lose security patches and stability fixes
backlog.recommendation: Phase 3 upgrade plan — verify compatibility before major bumps. Start with express (Backend) as it has the most security patches.

backlog.title: 6 frontend production files with zero test coverage
backlog.detail: Hooks (useDashboard, useWorkItems) are the primary data-fetching layer — failures silently break entire UI. Layout, PriorityBadge, StatusBadge, TypeBadge, DebugPortalPage all untested.
backlog.recommendation: Add renderHook tests for both hooks via @testing-library/react. Add smoke-render tests for badge/layout components. Single render test sufficient for DebugPortalPage (static iframe).

backlog.title: eslint-disable in production hooks without rationale — risk of stale closures
backlog.detail: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed at line 63 in useWorkItems.ts and line 82 in DependencyPicker.tsx. No explanation provided. Stale closures can cause fetches that never re-run when params change.
backlog.recommendation: Fix dependency arrays (preferred) or add inline comment explaining why suppression is safe.
